description: Given the file paths an agent is about to change (and optionally a subset being deleted), return the conventions, documentation gaps, and existing/related docs whose evidence overlaps those paths, plus a net-new/undocumented analysis and any removal candidates. Read-only; no side effects. Returns a Markdown report. Call this BEFORE writing code so doc updates land in the same PR; then use propose_doc_update to write a doc, or propose_doc_removal for an orphaned one.

changedPaths.description: Repository-relative file paths the agent intends to modify (e.g., apps/web/src/app/api/billing/webhook/route.ts).

deletedPaths.description: Subset of paths that are being DELETED. Moxie Docs flags any doc whose every cited source path is in this list as a removal candidate for moxie.propose_doc_removal.

repository.description: The target repository as "owner/name" (e.g. "acme/app"). Always pass this unless your token is scoped to a single repository. Matching is case-insensitive. If omitted when the token serves multiple repos, the call returns the list of repositories to choose from instead of an answer.

name: moxie.get_doc_impact
